games.heroDescription: Discover the Radix gaming universe. Connect your wallet, acquire your badge and compete in weekly tournaments to win real XRD prizes. With your badge you can register, record your scores, and win XRD prizes if you finish in the top 20% of players. Additionally, you can publish your own games, organize community tournaments, and earn a share of every prize pool.

devModal.title: Publish your game on Radix Games
devModal.intro: With your Radix Games badge you can publish your own games on the platform and make them accessible to the entire community. Any developer with a badge can upload their game, create tournaments and share their creations with thousands of players.
devModal.step1_desc: Obtain your developer badge by paying in XRD. The same badge lets you play in tournaments and publish your games.
devModal.step2_desc: Submit your game through the developer panel. Our team reviews it and publishes it on the platform.
devModal.step3_desc: Set up weekly tournaments for your game. Players pay in XRD to participate and compete for the prize pool.
devModal.step4_desc: Every time a tournament runs on your game, you receive a share of the revenue directly in XRD to your Radix wallet.
devModal.revenue_desc: From each tournament on your game, 80% goes to prizes, 15% goes to you as the developer in XRD, and the remaining 5% goes to the Radix community fund.
devModal.badge_note_desc: With a single badge paid in XRD you get access to compete in tournaments, register your scores and publish your own games.
devModal.cta: Get your badge and start creating

games.default_desc: Play now and compete for XRD prizes in weekly tournaments.

tournament.title: How Tournaments Work
tournament.registration_desc: To register in the tournament, acquire your badge for 5 dollars paid in XRD. This badge gives you access to compete in weekly tournaments and record your scores in the official leaderboard.
tournament.distribution_desc: The 80% of the revenue goes entirely to player prizes. The remaining 20% is reinvested in growing the Radix community. If 100,000 users register, the revenue totals $500,000 in XRD, of which $400,000 is distributed among the top 20,000 players (top 20%).
tournament.why_desc: We decided to reward such a wide percentage of players (the top 20%) to demonstrate the real potential of Radix as a payments and micropayments platform. Having 20,000 people receive XRD prizes is a powerful demonstration of the speed, scalability, and low cost of transactions on Radix. Join and be part of this historic demonstration!
tournament.duration_desc: Tournaments last one week. Register early to play more and maximize your chances of winning. The sooner you register, the more games you can accumulate!
